name: Natsu Doki! Harem ~Shinsekitaku de no Nayameru Juken Benkyou~
original_name: なつドキ！ハーレム～親せき宅での悩める受験勉強～
source:
Yuto failed a university entrance exam. He needs to study hard, but he is still down.... One day, his mother tells him to stay at Shizuru's house and study hard. Shizuru is his aunt and ex-teacher. When he arrives at her house, Shizuru and her daughters welcome him. He is surprised to see his beautifully grown up cousins. He soon decides to study hard there, but there are a lot of erotic temptations surrounded by beautiful girls....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
悠斗在大学入学考试中落榜。他本该努力学习，却仍然十分消沉…一天，母亲让他住到静流家专心备考。静流是他的姑母，也是从前的老师。抵达后，静流和女儿们欢迎了他。看见表姐妹们已经出落得如此美丽，悠斗大吃一惊。他很快决定在这里用功学习，身边却充满来自美丽女性的色情诱惑…
